faq: Will it close my Gmail, Google Docs or other web apps?

Only real duplicates close. Apps like Gmail use the part of the address after # for different screens, so your inbox and an open email are not treated as copies. Pinned tabs and tabs playing sound are never closed.
Will it mix up the order of my tabs?
No. DupTabOff never moves a tab when removing duplicates; it only closes the extra copies. The copy you're looking at, a pinned copy, or a copy inside one of your tab groups is the one that stays.
What is the difference between Free and Lifetime Pro?

The free version removes duplicates in the window you're in: your first 200 with no limit, then up to 10 per click. Lifetime Pro checks every window at once, stops duplicates before they open, and adds Undo, colour marks, snooze, saved sessions and clean-up tools.
No. Lifetime Pro is {price}, paid once, with no renewals. One license key works on up to 5 browsers. You can try every Pro feature free for 7 days first, with nothing to cancel.
Does DupTabOff collect my browsing data?

No. Your tabs are read only inside your browser and nothing about them is sent anywhere. There are no ads, no analytics and no account. The only time DupTabOff goes online is to check a Pro license key with Gumroad, the store that sells Pro.
Which browsers does it work in?

Chrome 88 or newer on Windows, Mac, Linux and ChromeOS, and Chromium browsers such as Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi. Chrome on phones doesn't support extensions. DupTabOff itself appears in English, German, French, Japanese or Spanish, following your browser's language.
Yes. If Pro doesn't work for you, email {email} within 14 days of buying and we'll refund you.

pw_desc: PryceHunt is a Chrome and Edge extension that shows what the product you are viewing costs at other Indian stores, with price history, honest sale facts and price-drop alerts. No account, no ads, no tracking.
pw_h1: Compare prices across Indian stores, right on the page
pw_lead: PryceHunt shows what the product you are looking at costs at other stores, how its price has moved, and whether that big discount is real. No account, no ads, no tracking: your pincode, settings and watch-list stay in your browser.
pw_f1_h: See other stores' prices without leaving the page
pw_f1_p: A small box under the price opens the comparison. Switch on “Show the price here instead of a link” and PryceHunt shows the other store's price in the box, marked “likely the same product” or “similar: check details”. You can switch that on or off right there.
pw_f1_pts: Live prices today for Amazon.in and Flipkart; the other stores open their own search
The cheapest store found is called out, and you can list the lowest price first
Quick-delivery apps are included, with prices per 100 g, per 100 ml or per piece
pw_f1_alt: PryceHunt's comparison box on a product page, showing a cheaper price at another store
pw_f2_h: A Compare button on every product
pw_f2_p: On search, category and home pages, and on the similar items of a product page, every product gets a small “Compare prices” button. Nothing is fetched until you press one.
pw_f2_pts: Amazon.in, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Ajio and Croma
Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket and Swiggy Instamart
Pause it for 30 minutes to 23 hours, on one site or on all sites
pw_f2_alt: A search results page where every product has a small Compare prices button, and one comparison is open
pw_f3_h: Price history and honest sale facts
pw_f3_p: PryceHunt remembers the prices you have seen and charts them. It shows the lowest price seen, checks a “70% off” claim against what the product has usually cost, and during big sales such as Diwali tells you what the product cost before the sale began.
pw_f3_pts: No verdict and no pressure: it states the facts and you decide
Sale dates are the usual timing, because shops announce theirs late; you can choose the seasons to follow and add your own
Optional shared history, built from prices other people chose to share anonymously
pw_f3_alt: PryceHunt's price history chart, the check of a 70 percent off claim and the price before a sale
pw_f4_p: Everything that contacts anything is off until you switch it on, and each setting says what is sent. Choose your stores and their order, where the box appears, and how it behaves.
pw_f4_pts: Live prices, alerts, price sharing and Telegram are separate switches
pw_f4_alt: PryceHunt's settings page, divided into General, Stores, Prices and alerts, and Privacy and data
pw_f5_p: The toolbar menu pauses PryceHunt for a while, keeps your watch-list and lets you set your pincode. Set an alert price or range for a product, choose which sites to watch during a sale, and get a notification when it drops.
pw_f5_pts: Alerts are checked while your browser is open. Some stores, such as Amazon.in, do not allow automatic checks, so those prices update when you open the product
Optional alerts on Telegram, to reach your phone
pw_f5_alt: PryceHunt's toolbar menu, with pause, the watch-list and a pincode box
pw_f6_h: Share a comparison with family and friends
pw_f6_p: Pressing Share makes a picture and a short message of the comparison, ready for WhatsApp or Telegram. It contains the product and prices only, nothing about you.
pw_f6_alt: A PryceHunt share card comparing the price of a phone at three stores
pw_promise_p: PryceHunt has no accounts, no advertising, no analytics and no tracking, and we never sell data. Your settings, pincode, watch-list and price history stay in your browser. A few optional features send limited information to our price server or to other services; each one is off until you switch it on, and the settings say exactly what is sent.
pw_good_pts: Products are matched by name, so a match can be wrong. Always check the details before you buy, and flag a wrong match or price.
When you click “Go to this store”, PryceHunt may add an affiliate link that earns us a commission at no cost to you, and it says so next to the button.
PryceHunt is independent and is not affiliated with any store or with Telegram.
pw_shops_p: Amazon.in, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Ajio, Croma, Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket and Swiggy Instamart. More Indian stores are added over time.
pw_pricing_p: PryceHunt is free while it is being launched. If a paid plan with higher limits is introduced later, we will say so well before anything changes.
pw_faq: Yes, while it is being launched. If a paid plan with higher limits comes later, we will tell you well before anything changes.
Which browsers does it work in?
Chrome and Edge on a computer. Other browsers may come later.
No. You never sign in, and your settings stay in your browser.

PryceHunt matches products by name, so it can be wrong: a different size, colour or model can look the same. It labels each match as “likely the same product” or “similar: check details”, and you can flag a wrong match or price.
Does PryceHunt see what I browse?

On the shopping sites it works on, it reads the product name and price on the page you are viewing, on your computer. It sends nothing by itself. A few optional features send limited information, each only after you switch it on.
Why can't alerts arrive while my browser is closed?

The price checks run in your browser, so they need it open. You can also let PryceHunt watch for you while the browser is closed, using prices that other people chose to share, and receive alerts on Telegram; this can miss some drops.
Does PryceHunt earn money from my purchases?

It may. When you click “Go to this store” and the store is cheaper or has an offer, PryceHunt may open an affiliate link that earns us a commission at no cost to you. It says so next to the button, and the link is added only when you click.
